title: TriCCOT: Tri-part Convolutional Conformal Transformer for Onboard Space Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.08659v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Onboard object detection in Earth observation is constrained by limited computational resources and the absence of fully corrected imagery. While convolutional detectors are hardware-efficient, they often struggle to extract robust representations from raw and noisy data. Conversely, transformer-based models provide stronger global reasoning capabilities but remain difficult to deploy on FPGA accelerators due to quadratic attention complexity and non-compatible operations.   We introduce TriCCOT, a tri-part architecture for robust and deployable onboard object detection. TriCCOT combines a convolutional region proposal network, a conformal prediction stage, and Aper-GATES, our hardware-friendly attention-based classifier. The region proposal network generates candidate bounding boxes, which are subsequently enlarged via conformal prediction, providing a distribution-free probabilistic coverage guarantee. translated_title: TriCCOT：面向在轨空间目标检测的三部分卷积保形Transformer
translated_abstract: 地球观测中的在轨目标检测受到计算资源有限以及缺乏完全校正图像的制约。尽管卷积检测器在硬件效率方面表现出色，但它们往往难以从原始和含噪数据中提取鲁棒的表征。相反，基于Transformer的模型具备更强的全局推理能力，但由于二次方的注意力复杂度和不兼容的运算操作，仍然难以部署在FPGA加速器上。我们提出了TriCCOT，这是一种用于鲁棒且可部署的在轨目标检测的三部分架构。TriCCOT结合了卷积区域提议网络、保形预测阶段以及Aper-GATES（我们提出的硬件友好的基于注意力的分类器）。区域提议网络生成候选边界框，随后通过保形预测对其进行扩大，从而提供无分布假设的概率覆盖保证。由此生成的裁剪图像被处理……（摘要原文不完整）
tldr: TriCCOT提出了一种融合卷积区域提议网络、保形预测和硬件友好注意力分类器的三部分架构，在计算资源受限的在轨平台上实现了鲁棒且可部署的空间目标检测。
